evidence.claim: The flagship trial of exactly this content model — Cooper/Fairburn's CBT for obesity, explicitly designed to prevent regain — produced ~10% initial loss, but at 3-year follow-up 'the great majority regained almost all the weight'; the authors concluded it is ethically questionable to claim psychological obesity treatments 'work' absent long-term data. A self-read 84-day lesson track is a homeopathic dose of a treatment that failed at full clinical dose.
evidence.source: Cooper Z, Fairburn CG et al., Behaviour Research and Therapy 2010; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20691328/

evidence.claim: What beats standard behavioral treatment is acceptance-based skill use at decision moments, not psychoeducation: Forman's Mind Your Health RCT (n=190) found acceptance-based treatment produced 13.3% vs 9.8% 12-month weight loss, with mechanisms of tolerating discomfort, values commitment, and mindful awareness 'during moments of decision-making'.
evidence.source: Forman EM et al., Obesity 2016; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27670400/

evidence.claim: Motivational interviewing produces small short-term weight effects (~1.5 kg) that are NOT sustained at 12 months; MI's value is as a conversational technique (autonomy support, evocation), which belongs inside jeni-chat's system prompt, not in a curriculum.
evidence.source: Armstrong 2011 meta-analysis (NCBI DARE NBK85396); Michalopoulou et al., Annals of Internal Medicine 2022, https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/10.7326/M21-3128

evidence.claim: Just-in-time adaptive interventions delivering content at moments of vulnerability/opportunity show medium-to-large effects vs non-JITAI delivery of comparable content — timing and context-matching, not content volume, is the active delivery variable.
evidence.source: Wang L & Miller LC, JITAI meta-analytic review, Health Communication 2019, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31488002/; Nahum-Shani et al. 2015 framework

evidence.claim: Implementation intentions — rehearsed if-then responses to concrete cues — carry d=0.65 across 94 tests (d=.27-.66 across a 642-test update, strongest when cue-contingent and rehearsed). THE REP is already this mechanism; it is currently mis-delivered on a calendar instead of on the cue.
evidence.source: Gollwitzer PM & Sheeran P, Advances in Experimental Social Psychology 2006; 642-test update, European Review of Social Psychology 2024, https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/abs/10.1080/10463283.2024.2334563

evidence.claim: Attrition is intrinsic to scheduled digital curricula: Eysenbach's law of attrition; only ~25% complete full interventions in routine care; median MOOC completion 12.6%. Pushing a daily lesson to 100% of users guarantees the curriculum is mostly unconsumed regardless of quality.
evidence.source: Eysenbach G, JMIR 2005, https://www.jmir.org/2005/1/e11/; Open Praxis MOOC completion review, https://openpraxis.org/articles/10.55982/openpraxis.16.3.606

evidence.claim: In the closest commercial analogue (Noom, n=35,921), outcomes ride on monitoring behaviors, not article reads: dinner-logging frequency was the strongest success predictor (OR=10.69) and weigh-in frequency protected against regain (OR=0.59) — mirroring JeniFit's own food-log 3.1x / weigh 2.7x D1 lifts.
evidence.source: Chin SO et al., Scientific Reports 2016, https://www.nature.com/articles/srep34563

evidence.claim: Maintenance is behavioral, not conceptual: 75-79% of National Weight Control Registry maintainers self-weigh at least weekly; decreased self-weighing frequency predicts regain (4.0 kg vs 1.1 kg over 1 year); 10-year maintenance tracks sustained self-monitoring, activity, and diet consistency — none of which a lesson row produces.
evidence.source: Butryn ML et al., Obesity 2007, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18198319/; Thomas JG et al. 10-year NWCR follow-up, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24355667/

evidence.claim: Self-Determination Theory evidence: autonomy-supportive delivery (choice, rationale, perspective) predicts adherence, retention, and weight loss, while directive/assigned formats hinder it — a required daily 'the method' checkable row is the controlled-motivation pattern, and a pull-based library plus opt-in ritual is the autonomy-supportive one.
evidence.source: Gorin AA et al. 2014, https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/23730718/; Ntoumanis et al. SDT-intervention meta-analysis, Health Psychology Review 2021, https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/full/10.1080/17437199.2020.1718529

evidence.claim: GLP-1-era behavioral support that improves adherence and post-discontinuation maintenance is practical wraparound care — protein adequacy, symptom-aware eating, self-monitoring, resistance training, hunger-rebound education at discontinuation — not a psychoeducation course; this maps to signal-triggered coaching, not scheduled lessons.
evidence.source: Nutrients 2026 narrative review, https://www.mdpi.com/2072-6643/18/11/1761; expert Delphi consensus on GLP-1 supportive care, ScienceDirect S2667368125000725

evidence.claim: Live app data (PostHog pull 2026-07-17, n=405): lessons — the only module pushed to every user daily — retain at exactly baseline (19.5% D1), while self-initiated behaviors lift: food logging 61% (3.1x), weigh 52%, breath 48% (2.5x), chat 71% (3.6x). Only 17% ever log; 83% of paying users face an empty signals band. After a year of daily delivery the lesson has had every chance to be the activation loop and is not.

Identity change — the app's 'becoming her' spine — forms from performance experiences (kept behaviors) that precede identity, which then reduces self-regulatory burden; identity is built by receipts of kept days, not by being taught about identity in lessons.
evidence.source: Caldwell AE et al., Maintain IT model, Translational Behavioral Medicine 2018, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6124500/; exercise/healthy-eater identity validation, PMC10885534

reasoning: The decision splits into two questions the current JeniMethod conflates: is the CONTENT valuable, and is the DELIVERY (a scheduled daily destination) valuable? The evidence answers differently for each, which is why the verdict is hybrid rather than disappear or pure infrastructure. On delivery, everything converges against the daily curriculum: the app's own n=405 shows the one module pushed to 100% of users retains at exactly baseline while every self-initiated behavior lifts 2.5-3.6x. The universal-assignment confound cuts the honest way — because everyone gets the lesson, D0 lesson-completers returning at baseline means completing it adds no incremental reason to come back; it has no tomorrow-hook, while a logged plate makes tomorrow's overnight window exist. Eysenbach's law of attrition and MOOC data say scheduled digital curricula are mostly unconsumed by design; SDT says a required assigned row is the controlled-motivation pattern that suppresses adherence; and it currently spends a required slot in Today's receipt arithmetic that the retention war (17% ever log, first-plate problem) needs for behaviors. On content, the picture is more forgiving but redirects the format: Cooper/Fairburn's own 3-year data shows didactic CBT-for-obesity failed at full clinical dose, so an 84-lesson self-read course has no efficacy claim to protect. What does carry evidence is precisely the atoms already inside JeniMethod: acceptance/values skills used at decision moments (Forman +3.5% at 12mo), cue-contingent rehearsed if-then responses (Gollwitzer d=0.65 — THE REP is literally this mechanism, mis-delivered on a calendar), MI as conversational register (works in dialogue, decays as a program), and JITAI evidence that the same content moment-matched beats it scheduled. NWCR and Noom's n=35,921 confirm outcomes ride on monitored behaviors the lessons should be steering toward, not on reads. So the curriculum-as-course dies, the content becomes the coach's ammunition, fired at the moments the literature says it works: the up-weigh-in morning gets the scale-morning reframe, the heavy-evening signal gets the craving-wave rep, the 4-day absence gets begin-again. Why not pure invisible_infrastructure: a paying user bought 'a method,' and the perceived value of that noun is real even where use is low (belief value, differentiation from 'just another tracker'); the 17% who do read include the historically highest-engaging cohort; and the lesson quote share card is a live acquisition lever. Those justify a demoted, pull-only, zero-maintenance shelf — not a schedule. The verdict is decisive where it counts: the daily lesson row, the day-N pacing, and lesson-as-receipt-arithmetic all die; JeniMethod stops being a place she must go and becomes the way jeni coaches, with the method still visible, named, and browsable for whoever reaches for it.
design: 1) THE ATOM STORE (where CBT/ACT/MI content lives). The manifest's 84 lessons decompose into a typed CoachContentStore: mechanism lines (1-2 sentences), reframes, micro-skills, rep scenarios, evidence anchors — same JSON assets, re-indexed by TRIGGER CONTEXT instead of canonicalDay. The six pillars become trigger domains: P1 food-noise → evening/craving states; P2 satiety + urge surfing → post-meal receipts and GLP-1 fuel frames; P3 all-or-nothing → post-lapse and re-entry after absence; P4 identity → milestone receipts only; P5 sleep/stress → short-night mornings; P6 maintenance → keeping-chapter band events. Cohort-variant selection (GLP-1/postpartum/restrictive/perimenopause) transfers 1:1 to atom selection. The scheduler's anti-adjacency logic survives as anti-repetition (an atom never fires twice within N days). 2) HOW IT REACHES HER (all delivery through surfaces that already lift retention). (a) The morning reading: DailyBriefEngine gains one method line matched to her live signal state — short night fires the P5 'today runs gentler on purpose' atom; provenance-only law holds, no signal → no atom. (b) Post-signal notes: the up-weigh-in morning attaches the scale-morning reframe ('two pounds of chemistry... the line already knows') directly to the weight card; MealMoves/KitchenSignal receipts carry P2 one-liners. (c) THE REP, promoted and re-cued: a 20-40s door-choice practice OFFERED when its trigger is live — evening + heavy-evening-sugar pattern → craving_wave at ~8:30pm; 3+ day absence → begin_again on reopen; first band-zone drift in keeping → maintenance rep. Cap one offer/day, always skippable, never in receipt arithmetic; doors keep their routes (breath/snap/trend/chat-seed). This inverts v3's chain: the rep is primary, the full lesson one quiet tap deeper. (d) jeni-chat: system prompt gains the pillar playbook + MI register (open questions, reflections, autonomy affirmation) + the atom store as retrieval context, so 'i ate the cookies' surfaces the what-the-hell-effect reframe conversationally. (e) Notifications: evening JITAI probes drawn from P1/P2 atoms replace generic reminders, inside the existing under-5/week ceiling and cohort compliance floors. 3) WHAT THE DAILY SURFACE SHOWS. Today's required rows become behaviors only (snap, weigh, steps, auto overnight-fast); 'the method' row dies and its slot is gone, not replaced with more content. Method presence on Today is ambient: the reading's method line and at most one rep offer. 4) THE SHELF (the visible remnant). 'the method' becomes a pull-only library one level inside becoming: all 84 lessons + 42 hero photos + the built reader + share cards, ordered by the scheduler's act/pillar logic, no day numbers as obligations, no push, no completion tracking as debt. Users who want the morning-read ritual opt IN via a setting ('keep the daily read') — chosen, not assigned (SDT). Every moment-matched atom carries a provenance tag ('from the method · urge surfing') that names what she bought and doors into the shelf. 5) ROLLOUT. Behind JeniMethodFeatureFlag; measure D1 by cohort week, first-session food-log rate (17→40% target), rep-offer acceptance; guardrails = paywall conversion and the reader-cohort's W1→W2 retention. Wall/onboarding copy shifts from 'a daily 2-minute lesson' to the method as how jeni coaches — referencing only shipped surfaces.
what_survives: The 84 authored lesson bodies + cohort variants — atomized into the CoachContentStore as the coaching knowledge base (the writing is the asset; the schedule was the liability)
The 42 Grok hero photos + the built LessonReaderView — power the pull-only method shelf at zero new build cost

THE REP mechanic + the 16 authored scenarios — promoted to the primary practice atom, re-cued by signal triggers (the one piece with d=0.65-class evidence behind its exact mechanism); future authoring extends by trigger, not by day
The lesson quote share card — retained as the organic acquisition lever, reachable from the shelf
CBTCurriculumScheduler's invariants (pillar coverage, anti-adjacency, cohort-variant priority) — repurposed as shelf ordering + atom anti-repetition logic
The 'JeniMethod' brand noun itself — kept as provenance ('from the method') so the purchase promise stays visible while delivery goes ambient
risks: Perceived-value dilution: she bought 'a method'; if onboarding/wall keep selling a daily curriculum she can no longer find, expect refund pressure and review damage — copy must shift the same release, and the shelf must stay discoverable (guardrail metric: paywall conversion + refund rate)

The engaged minority loses a ritual: the ~17% readers overlap the historically highest-engaging cohort (lessons+breath 75%+ era); without the opt-in 'keep the daily read' setting, this cohort's W1→W2 retention could drop — watch it as a named guardrail

Cold-start thinness for the 83% passive majority: moment-matched atoms need live signals; users with empty bands need time-of-day + cohort-prior fallbacks or they receive LESS coaching than today's guaranteed (if ignored) lesson

Attribution error: the food/chat/breath retention lifts are self-selected, so killing the lesson row will not mechanically transfer attention to behaviors — the freed surface must actively point at the snap (v6.3's days-1-2 one-thing already does), and results need cohort-week reads, not day-over-day

Compliance and sensitivity in push delivery: notification-fired atoms inherit the manifest's lint rules (no drug names, no prescriptive fasting vocabulary, under-5/week ceiling), and the body-image content (locked days 47/60/78/83) must remain shelf-and-chat only — never notification-pushed
